description: Thresholds for the local conditional hypothesis Brain. Every value here is a development default chosen so the five lifecycle operations are reachable on a short replay; none has been fitted or validated against out-of-sample outcomes.

trajectory.identity: the ATR-normalized cumulative return curve, projected onto a globally fitted principal basis. Realized volatility is an attribute and never an identity dimension.

proposer._minimum_mass_note: The share of the retrieved neighbourhood a cluster needs before it is surfaced as a representative future. Mass below this is left to the residual rather than named.

pool._association_note: A hypothesis keeps its identity only if this clock's matched node lies within association_max_distance in the principal basis. The gate is what separates a real change of claim from clustering jitter, and churn_diagnostics measures whether it is set sensibly.
